extended-profile.metric: 1.1 Number of students year wise during the last five years.

findings.query: Admission approval documents received from the university for assessment period.
Consolidated year wise list of students approved by the affiliating University.
Consolidated authenticated year-wise, semester -wise list of students on HEI's letterhead.
Total number of students on rolls across all the programs (consider 1st ,2nd, 3rd years etc., of each program) for all the assessment period years

extended-profile.metric: 2.1 Number of teaching staff / full time teachers during the last five years (Without repeat count):

findings.query: Consolidated list of total full time teachers in block five years (Without repeat count) indicating the departmental affiliation during the assessment period authenticated by the Principal/competent authority.

extended-profile.metric: 2.2 Number of teaching staff / full time teachers year wise during the last five years

findings.query: Consolidated list of all full time teachers year-wise indicating the departmental affiliation during the assessment period authenticated by the Principal/ Competent authority.

extended-profile.metric: 3.1 Expenditure excluding salary component year wise during the last five years (INR in lakhs)

findings.query: Audited statement of income and expenditure duly certified by the Principal and Chartered Accountant in case of privately funded institutions highlighting the salary component, depreciation and excess of income over expenditure.
Statement showing the total expenditure excluding the salary component for each of the years certified by the Principal and Chartered Accountant.

criterion-1.metric: 1.2.1 Number of Certificate/Value added courses offered and online courses of MOOCs, SWAYAM, NPTEL etc. (where the students of the institution have enrolled and successfully completed during the last five years)

findings.query: Name of the program duration, list of students enrolled (with signature of students), model certificates, curriculum, assessment procedures year-wise.
2. Certificates and attendance sheets.

criterion-1.metric: 1.2.2 Percentage of students enrolled in Certificate/ Value added courses and also completed online courses of MOOCs, SWAYAM, NPTEL etc. as against the total number of students during the last five years.

findings.query: Consolidated year-wise list of the students enrolled in the Program as defined in 1.2.1 2.
2. Attendance sheet of students participating with signature and Model Certificates.

criterion-1.metric: 1.3.2 Percentage of students undertaking project work/field work/ internships (Data for the latest completed academic year)

findings.query: Consolidated authenticated list of students along with the details of title, place of work, duration etc.,
Internship completion certificate / project work completion certificate from the organization where internship / project was completed.
Report of the field work/sample photographs of the field work / permission letter only for field work from the competent authority.

criterion-1.metric: 1.4.1 Institution obtains feedback on the academic performance and ambience of the institution from various stakeholders, such as Students, Teachers, Employers, Alumni etc. and action taken report on the feedback is made available on institutional website

findings.query: Sample Filled in feedback forms from at least two stakeholders.
Stakeholders’ feedback analysis report.
Action taken report on feedback.
Document showing the communication with the affiliating University for the Feedback provided.
Link to the HEI's website which shows the feedback available on HEI's website.
1. Sanction of intake from affiliating University/ Government/statutory body for first-year students only.
2. Approved admission list year-wise/ program-wise from the Affiliating University

criterion-2.metric: 2.1.2 Percentage of seats filled against reserved categories (SC, ST, OBC, etc.) as per applicable reservation policy for the first-year admission during the last five years

findings.query: 1. Letter issued by state govt. or Central Government indicating the reserved categories as per the state rule (in English as applicable).
2. Number of seats year-wise earmarked for the reserved categories
3. Admission extract submitted to the state OBC, SC, and ST cell every year for the first-year students
4. Approval of additional intake of students.

criterion-2.metric: 2.2.1 Student – Full-time Teacher Ratio (Data for the latest completed academic year)

findings.query: 1. List of the full-time teachers along with the departmental affiliation in the latest completed academic year
2. List of the students across all year in each of the programs in the latest completed year

criterion-2.metric: 2.4.1 Percentage of full-time teachers against sanctioned posts during the last five years

findings.query: Sanction letters (in English) indicating the number of posts (including management-sanctioned posts) by the competent authority
Appointment letters of teachers

criterion-2.metric: 2.4.2 Percentage of full time teachers with NET/SET/SLET/ Ph. D./D.Sc. / D.Litt./L.L.D. during the last five years (consider only highest degree for count)

findings.query: List of faculties having NET/SET/SLET/ Ph. D. / D.M. / M.Ch. / D.N.B Super specialty / D.Sc. / D.Litt. and any other post doctoral degree should be provided as per academic session wise along with particulars of degree awarding university, subject and the year of award.
Doctorate and D.Sc. / D.Litt./L.L.D Degree Certificate and NET/SET/SLET certificates awarded by UGC-recognized universities

criterion-2.metric: 2.6.3 Pass percentage of Students during last five years (excluding backlog students)

findings.query: 1. Result sheet published by the affiliating university

2. Certified report from Head of Institution/Controller of Examination of the affiliating university indicating pass percentage of students of the final year (final semester) eligible for the degree program wise/year wise

criterion-3.metric: 3.2.2 Number of workshops/seminars/conferences including on Research Methodology, Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) and entrepreneurship conducted during the last five years

findings.query: Brochure/Geotagged Photograph with date and captions; title of the workshops / seminars conducted.
2 . Link to Detailed report of each program as in the template.
3 . Consolidated list of workshops/seminars/conferences including programs conducted on Research Methodology, Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) and entrepreneurship year wise during last five years.
4. Attendance Sheets

findings.query: 1. Link landing to the Research paper
Link to the journal website.
URL of the content page of the print journal.
Data template indicating presence of the paper in the UGC CARE list, Scopus and Web Of Science.

criterion-3.metric: 3.3.2 Number of books and chapters in edited volumes/books published and papers published in national/ international conference proceedings per teacher during last five years

findings.query: Cover page, content page and first page of the Publication
Web-link of Books.

criterion-3.metric: 3.4.3 Number of extension and outreach programs conducted by the institution through organized forums including NSS/NCC with involvement of community during the last five years.

findings.query: Geo tagged Photographs and any other supporting document of relevance should have proper captions and dates.
Detailed report for each extension and outreach program with specific mention of number of students participated and collaborating agency.

criterion-3.metric: 3.5.1 Number of functional MoUs/linkages with institutions/ industries in India and abroad for internship, on-the-job training, project work, student / faculty exchange and collaborative research during the last five years.

findings.query: Copies of MOUs/ collaboration/ related documents indicating the nature of collaboration and activities year-wise.
List of activities conducted under each MoU along with dates of starting and completion year-wise signed by both parties.

Relevant items in the audited income and expenditure statement.

Stock entry of computers allotted for student use.

criterion-4.metric: 4.4.1 Percentage expenditure incurred on maintenance of physical facilities and academic support facilities excluding salary component, during the last five years (INR in Lakhs)
